top_stories.title: Baltic Sea Maritime Security Incident
top_stories.summary: A cargo vessel traveling toward Russia suffered damage and caught fire following a drone strike in the Gulf of Finland. Finnish authorities characterized the maritime security breach as a significant escalation representing the spillover of the wider war.

top_stories.title: European Union Budgetary Disputes
top_stories.summary: Proposed financial spending cuts introduced ahead of an upcoming summit have intensified political friction among member states. The fiscal strategy aims to implement substantial reductions while managing differing regional priorities.
